presets.name: VideoMAE Deepfake Detector
presets.subtitle: Temporal video model · FaceForensics++
presets.summary: Community VideoMAE fine-tuned on FaceForensics++—best for demos and offline GPU use. Expect domain shift vs full-scene consumer MP4; for NVIDIA-calibrated production scoring use Serverless (NVCF).
presets.metrics_hint: ~88% accuracy · ~0.84 AUC on FF++ (per model card)

more_info.what_it_offers: Binary real vs fake scores using 16-frame VideoMAE clips—temporal patterns across the video, not single frames.
more_info.best_for: Face-centric manipulation similar to FaceForensics++ (deepfakes, reenactment-style clips), offline GPU inference in your CAI pod.
more_info.limitations: Trained on an FF++ subset; may not match NVIDIA-hosted Synthetic Video Detector on general consumer MP4. Needs visible faces and reasonable resolution.
highlights: Fine-tuned on FaceForensics++ at C23 compression

presets.name: AI vs Deepfake vs Real
presets.subtitle: SigLIP encoder · three-way classification
presets.summary: Separates fully AI-generated, deepfake-manipulated, and authentic stills—aggregated over sampled video frames.
presets.metrics_hint: Useful when you need to distinguish full AI synthesis from face-swap deepfakes

more_info.what_it_offers: Three-way classification (AI-generated vs deepfake-manipulated vs real) on sampled frames, rolled up to a video-level synthetic score.
more_info.best_for: Editorial triage when you care about the type of manipulation, not only binary synthetic probability.
more_info.limitations: Frame-based SigLIP path—not full temporal VideoMAE. Requires torchvision in the runtime image. Heavier than the ViT preset.
highlights: SigLIP vision encoder with a classification head
Aggregates scores across uniformly sampled frames
See the model card for class definitions and training data

presets.name: Deepfake vs Real (ViT)
presets.subtitle: Lightweight binary classifier
presets.summary: Compact ViT-style binary detector—good for demos, smoke tests, and smaller GPUs.
presets.metrics_hint: Lower VRAM · faster cold start than VideoMAE

more_info.what_it_offers: Fast binary fake vs real classification on sampled frames with lower GPU memory than VideoMAE.
more_info.best_for: Smoke tests, smaller GPUs, and quick Launchpad demos when temporal modeling is not required.
more_info.limitations: Image classifier on frame samples—misses temporal cues that VideoMAE targets. Same domain-shift caveats as other open HF checkpoints.
highlights: Good default when VRAM or startup time is tight
Pair with short, face-forward clips for clearer results
